executive_summary:
Episode 36 combines (a) host's reconstruction of a multi-month timeline linking the Macron investigation to events surrounding the Charlie Kirk assassination, much of which is host narration referencing prior-episode material, with (b) four distinct artifact-anchored evidentiary segments presented in this episode. The artifact-anchored material consists of: (1) a displayed text exchange between host and Charlie Kirk from February 24–25, 2025 documenting White House and POTUS-side contact regarding the Macron topic; (2) a displayed internal legal-team communication from July 27, 2025 analyzing Delaware jurisdictional defects in the Macron lawsuit; (3) an audio/video clip from Brian Harpole's appearance on the Shawn Ryan show in which he read aloud text messages between Dan Flood and UVU Police Chief Jeff Long about student roof access, presented in a manner the host asserts was misrepresentative; and (4) a KUTV investigative report documenting that Washington County Sheriff's office states Tyler Robinson surveillance footage is no longer available, citing a 30-day retention period. A Tucker Carlson speech clip from the July 18 Turning Point event is also played. The episode does not present new primary artifacts supporting the bulk of the host's broader timeline claims about the Satys hanger, the Egyptian plane schedule, the foreign-dignitary transfer, the MK Ultra / Stanford line of investigation, or the phone calls with Andrew Kolvet and the unnamed CIA-contractor spouse; these are preserved as host assertions and excluded from the Claim Register per the admission test.

---

sub_items.description: Displayed text exchange between Candace Owens and Charlie Kirk (Feb 24–25, 2025), including Charlie's message "Hey, I have something to tell you from the White House. They asked me to call you. I'm just the messenger here, but it's important," host's reply, follow-up exchange about circling back, and Charlie's Feb 25 text "The White House just asked for your number FYI. I think POTUS might call you."

Displayed private communication between host and her legal team (July 27, 2025), including counsel's assessment that the Macron lawsuit should be dismissed for forum non conveniens, citing host's Tennessee domicile, lack of Delaware defamation, witnesses in Tennessee, and Macron parties not being Delaware citizens.

Audio/video clip from the Shawn Ryan show featuring Brian Harpole (Turning Point USA head of security), including his reading of the Flood–Long text exchange and his characterization of his communication with UVU Police Chief Jeff Long.

Text exchange between Dan Flood (Turning Point USA security) and UVU Police Chief Jeff Long, read aloud by Brian Harpole during the Shawn Ryan interview, covering student roof access at the Sorensen Center (with staircases to walkways/roofs), the request for controlled access or TP personnel presence, and Chief Long's response "I got you covered."

Audio/video clip of KUTV investigative report on missing Washington County Sheriff's office surveillance footage of Tyler Robinson, including Sheriff Nate Brooksby's September 17, 2025 press conference ("Our job was not to interview. Our job was just to get him here" / "Within the hour, my friend drove Tyler and his parents to my office where he was greeted by plain clothes detectives"), records-request responses stating no records responsive and Robinson "did not go to the jail area," and the later response citing the "30-day retention period."
